rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of 'this$' fields in v1 decoder readObject
rawFindings.explanation: 'this$' prefixed fields are skipped incorrectly after reading key, but value was not read yet, causing misaligned reads and incorrect object properties.
rawFindings.suggestion: Read the value first before reading the next label, then conditionally assign to object if key does not match /^this\$\d+$/. Add 'var value = this.read(withType); label = this.byteBuffer.getChar();' before the assignment and apply the condition.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect handling of 'this$' fields in v2 decoder readObject
rawFindings.explanation: In v2 decoder's readObject method, the field value is stored regardless of its name, causing 'this$' prefixed fields to be incorrectly included, potentially breaking the object structure.
rawFindings.suggestion: Read the value first, then conditionally assign to the result.$ object if the field name does not match /^this\$\d+$/ (skip such fields). Insert code to read value and conditionally assign as done in v1 decoder.
